"""Compare actual original native operands/states with independently qualified GB10."""
from array import array
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
B=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def file_id(p):return dict(file=str(p.relative_to(B)),bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(p))

def compare(a,ak,b,bk,rows,cols,astride=None,aoffset=0,bstride=None,boffset=0):
    command=[str(B/'prefix-linear-compare-r1'),str(a),ak,str(b),bk,str(rows),str(cols),
             str(astride or cols),str(aoffset),str(bstride or cols),str(boffset)]
    run=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
    run.check_returncode();result=json.loads(run.stdout)
    result.update(native=file_id(a),reference=file_id(b),command=command)
    return result

def canonical_state(source,destination,layout):
    assert sys.byteorder=='little' and source.stat().st_size==524288*4
    bits=array('I');bits.frombytes(source.read_bytes())
    if layout=='key-major':
        canonical=array('I',[0])*524288
        for h in range(32):
            for v in range(128):
                for k in range(128):canonical[h*16384+v*128+k]=bits[h*16384+k*128+v]
    else:
        assert layout=='value-major';canonical=bits
    with destination.open('xb') as f:f.write(canonical.tobytes())
    return destination

def main():
    tool=read(B/'prefix-linear-compare-local-r1.json')
    assert sha(B/'prefix_linear_compare_r1.cpp')==tool['source_sha256']
    assert sha(B/'prefix-linear-compare-r1')==tool['binary_sha256']
    name='prefix96-linear-capture-r1';d=B/name;c=d/'capture/linear-16'
    s=read(B/'prefix96-linear-capture-source-r1.json');r=read(d/'run-record.json')
    assert r['host'].lower()=='baiying' and r['reason']=='completed' and r['exit_code']==0
    assert r['host_checks_pass'] and all(r['host_checks'].values()) and not r['after_processes']
    assert r['spec']['command_file_sha256']==s['script_sha256']==sha(B/s['script'])
    assert sha(B/s['dispatcher'])==s['dispatcher_sha256']
    assert (r['summary']['input_tokens'],r['summary']['output_tokens'])==(98304,1)
    assert not r['spec']['expected_product_output_supplied']
    capture=read(d/'capture-manifest.json');assert capture['source_commit']==s['whole_source_commit']
    assert capture['archive_sha256']==sha(d/'capture.tar')
    for f in capture['files']:
        p=d/'capture'/f['file'];assert p.stat().st_size==f['bytes'] and sha(p)==f['sha256']
    record=read(c/'capture.json')
    assert record['complete'] and (record['layer'],record['first_position'],record['tokens'])==(16,90112,8192)
    assert record['original_launch_count']==1
    reference=B/'qrt-gb10-prefix128-layer16-20260919-r1'
    authority=read(reference/'boundary-analysis.json')
    assert authority['reference_qualified'] and authority['original512_output_ids_and_full_first_logits_reproduced']
    assert authority['window']['plan']==dict(layer=16,first_position=90112,tokens=8192)
    targets=authority['target_files']
    for f in targets.values():
        p=B/f['local_file'];assert p.stat().st_size==f['bytes'] and sha(p)==f['sha256']
    out=d/'analysis-original-linear-r1';out.mkdir()
    comparisons={}
    for key,offset,cols in [('q-core-input',0,2048),('k-core-input',2048,2048),('v-core-input',4096,4096)]:
        f=targets[key];comparisons[key]=compare(c/'raw-f32.bin','f32',B/f['local_file'],f['dtype'],8192,cols,8192,offset)
    for key,offset in [('g-core-input',0),('beta-core-input',32)]:
        f=targets[key];comparisons[key]=compare(c/'gates-f32.bin','f32',B/f['local_file'],f['dtype'],8192,32,64,offset)
    f=targets['core'];comparisons['core']=compare(c/'output-f32.bin','f32',B/f['local_file'],f['dtype'],8192,4096)
    for key in ('initial-state','final-state'):
        original=c/(key+'-f32.bin');p=canonical_state(original,out/(key+'-canonical-f32.bin'),record['state_layout'])
        f=targets[key];comparisons[key]=compare(p,'f32',B/f['local_file'],'f32',1,524288)
        comparisons[key]['original_native_file']=file_id(original)
        comparisons[key]['native_layout']=record['state_layout']
        comparisons[key]['bit_preserving_axis_transpose']=record['state_layout']=='key-major'

    row_ref=B/'qrt-gb10-prefix128-moe16-20260919-r1';qualified=read(row_ref/'boundary-analysis.json')
    assert qualified['reference_qualified'] and qualified['original512_output_ids_and_full_first_logits_reproduced']
    case=next(x for x in read(row_ref/'capture/capture.json')['cases'] if x['name']=='long-prefix131072-owner-out512')
    w=case['worker']['runtime_boundaries']
    selected=[(t,i,q) for t in w['transactions'] for i,q in enumerate(t['qualified_rows']) if q['position']==98303]
    assert len(selected)==1;t,ri,q=selected[0];assert q['matches_generated_history'] and t['ordinal']==11
    mapping={'qkv_projection':('qkv',8192),'z_projection':('z-projection',4096),
        'a_projection':('a-projection',32),'b_projection':('b-projection',32),
        'core':('core',4096),'gated_rmsnorm':('gated',4096),'out_projection':('output-projection',2048)}
    terminal={}
    for surface,(label,width) in mapping.items():
        paths=list(c.glob('terminal-'+surface+'-*.bin'));assert len(paths)==1
        actual=paths[0];ak='bf16' if actual.name.endswith('-bf16.bin') else 'f32'
        f=next(f for f in w['files'].values() if f['transaction']==t['ordinal'] and f['label']=='linear-16-'+label)
        original=row_ref/'capture'/case['name']/f['file'];assert original.stat().st_size==f['bytes'] and sha(original)==f['sha256']
        data=original.read_bytes();size=2 if f['dtype']=='bf16' else 4
        assert len(data)==len(t['qualified_rows'])*width*size
        reference_row=out/('reference-'+surface+'-'+f['dtype']+'.bin')
        with reference_row.open('xb') as handle:handle.write(data[ri*width*size:(ri+1)*width*size])
        terminal[surface]=compare(actual,ak,reference_row,f['dtype'],1,width)
        terminal[surface].update(original_reference_file=file_id(original),original_reference_row=q)
    # Check that later row observation still sees the original seeded output.
    with (c/'output-f32.bin').open('rb') as f:
        f.seek(8191*4096*4);last=f.read(4096*4)
    assert last==(c/'terminal-core-f32.bin').read_bytes()
    proof=dict(kind='actual_original_prefix_linear_window_comparison',host='baiying',model=r['spec']['model'],
        source_commit=s['whole_source_commit'],source_manifest=file_id(B/'prefix96-linear-capture-source-r1.json'),
        command_file=r['spec']['command_file'],command_file_sha256=r['spec']['command_file_sha256'],
        run_record=file_id(d/'run-record.json'),capture_manifest=file_id(d/'capture-manifest.json'),
        host_checks=r['host_checks'],summary=r['summary'],capture_record=record,
        reference_analysis=file_id(reference/'boundary-analysis.json'),selected_row_reference_analysis=file_id(row_ref/'boundary-analysis.json'),
        full_window=comparisons,terminal_rows=terminal,core_terminal_unchanged_after_original_launch=True,
        observer=file_id(Path(__file__)),comparison_tool_validation=tool,
        selected_terminal_row_only_for_projections=True,
        diagnostic_only=True,inference_acceptance=False,performance_acceptance=False,release_qualified=False)
    path=d/'linear-boundary-analysis-r1.json'
    with path.open('x') as f:json.dump(proof,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(file=str(path.relative_to(B)),sha256=sha(path),
        window={k:v['summary'] for k,v in comparisons.items()},terminal={k:v['summary'] for k,v in terminal.items()}),indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Read original reference model tensors; no model execution or GPU use."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,socket,struct,time
assert socket.gethostname()=='aitopatom-66c4'
root=Path('<private-home>/prefix128-layer16-projection-weights-r1');root.mkdir()
model=Path('/mnt/data/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B')
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with p.open('rb') as f:
        for part in iter(lambda:f.read(8<<20),b''):h.update(part)
    return h.hexdigest()
start=time.monotonic()
index=model/'model.safetensors.index.json'
assert sha(index)=='41b9356101ebf8e7519e150dc811f80c4226e727301fbb032b890f006ed0be83'
assert sha(model/'config.json')=='93a4693fa9d8392fbfccd4b3c9873f4bfdcb14fdede978b123d07d19675efe99'
mapping=json.loads(index.read_text())['weight_map'];prefix='model.language_model.layers.16.'
targets={'linear_attn.out_proj.weight':[2048,4096],
    'linear_attn.in_proj_qkv.weight':[8192,2048],
    'linear_attn.in_proj_z.weight':[4096,2048],
    'linear_attn.norm.weight':[128],
    'post_attention_layernorm.weight':[2048]}
files=[];shards={}
for name,shape in targets.items():
    key=prefix+name;shard=mapping[key];path=model/shard
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        header_size=struct.unpack('<Q',f.read(8))[0];assert 0<header_size<=16<<20
        header=json.loads(f.read(header_size));entry=header[key]
        assert entry['dtype']=='BF16' and entry['shape']==shape
        first,last=entry['data_offsets'];elements=1
        for axis in shape:elements*=axis
        assert last-first==elements*2 and 8+header_size+last<=path.stat().st_size
        offset=8+header_size+first;f.seek(offset);raw=f.read(last-first)
    assert len(raw)==elements*2
    file=name.replace('.','-')+'-bf16.bin';destination=root/file
    with destination.open('xb') as f:f.write(raw)
    files.append(dict(key=key,shape=shape,dtype='bf16',shard=shard,offset=offset,file=file,
        bytes=len(raw),sha256=sha(destination)))
